clues: This town sits in the north of Venezuela. It lies close to Caracas, the main capital city.
The sun shines here all year round. Rain falls on just sixty days each year, and the air stays warm.
It led its state from 1904 to 1928. Then that role moved on to Petare.
Farms here grow cocoa, coffee and sugar cane. Pigs and cattle graze in the green fields near town.
Look for the shire town of Lander, in Miranda State. That clue should point you right to this town.
